sampling: Ascending SHA256([seed,pair_id,sample]); first quota eligible unique pairs passing screen; swap by SHA256([seed,pair_id,swap]) parity. No PRNG.
label_rule: Sum helpfulness, correctness and coherence with equal weight; higher total wins; equal totals excluded. Native preference label retained only in audit.
caveat: Complexity and verbosity are excluded. Equal-weight quality sum is a derived preference proxy, not the native human pairwise preference.
screen: Exact normalized text >=8 words and >=80% 16-word-shingle containment with >=5 shared shingles, all state strings. Not a guarantee against paraphrases or shared ancestry.
cache: Current cache run targets earlier 4303 source pool. New HelpSteer2 pair requests need additional forward extraction; existing single-rating caches are incompatible.
